description: vuln_mosaic CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in. The depends_on closure is empty, so the install set is the plugin itself; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, and any step that reaches the network (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/vuln-mosaic-tap@<commit>#ci' --dev-plugins vuln_mosaic
